'''''Cladium mariscus''''' is a species of flowering plant in the [[Cyperaceae|sedge family]] known by the common names '''swamp sawgrass''',<ref>{{PLANTS|id=CLMA10|taxon=Cladium mariscus|accessdate=17 January 2016}}</ref> '''great fen-sedge''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> '''saw-sedge''' or '''sawtooth sedge'''. Previously it was known as '''elk sedge'''.{{citation needed|date=May 2025}} It is native of temperate Europe and Asia where it grows in [[alkali soil|base-rich]] boggy areas and lakesides. It can be up to {{convert|2.5|m}} tall, and has leaves with hard serrated edges.<ref name=Theocharopoulos>{{cite journal|last=Theocharopoulos|first=Michael|author2=Georgiadis, Theodoros|author3=Dimitrellos, Georgios|author4=Chochliouros, Stergios|author5=Tiniakou, Argyro|year=2006|title=Vegetation types with ''Cladium mariscus'' (Cyperaceae) in Greece|journal=[[Willdenowia (journal)|Willdenowia]]|volume=36|issue=Special Issue|pages=247–256|url=http://www.bgbm.org/willdenowia/w-pdf/wi36-1Theocharopoulos+al.pdf|doi=10.3372/wi.36.36120|s2cid=86099302|access-date=2011-04-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110927095921/http://www.bgbm.org/willdenowia/w-pdf/wi36-1Theocharopoulos+al.pdf|archive-date=2011-09-27|url-status=dead}}</ref> In the past, it was an important material to build [[thatching|thatched roofs]]; harvesting it was an arduous task due to its sharp edges that can cause deep lacerations.<ref>[[The Worst Jobs in History|The Worst Rural Jobs in History]], Channel 4, 2006</ref>

==Subspecies==

*''C. m. californicum'' <small>(S.Watson) Govaerts</small> - California, Arizona, New Mexico, Nevada, Utah, Texas, Sonora, Coahuila
*''C. m. intermedium'' Kük. - Australia, New Caledonia
*''C. m. jamaicense'' (Crantz) Kük. - Latin America from Mexico to Argentina; West Indies; southeastern United States from Texas to Delaware; naturalized in tropical Africa and on many oceanic islands including Canary Islands, Madagascar, New Guinea, Hawaii
*''C. m. mariscus'' - Europe, northern Asia and North Africa from Ireland and Morocco to Japan, including Germany, Italy, France, Scandinavia, Poland, Balkans, Ukraine, Russia, Siberia, Saudi Arabia, Iran, Himalayas, Kazakhstan, China, Korea
